intro: You keep gravitating toward coastal cities, from Lisbon and Barcelona to Sydney and Cape Town—so a trip with salt air and a strong waterfront seems right up your alley.

suggestions.reason: Its Atlantic setting and walkable riverfront continue the coastal-city thread in your Lisbon photos.
Valencia pairs Mediterranean beaches with the urban energy that links your Barcelona and Sydney stops.
Its historic waterfront and Caribbean light offer another warm coastal city in the spirit of Cape Town and Lisbon.
